text:
Marta: Quick planning thread — two-week focus on Private deploy upgrade ergonomics: installer egress-preserve mode, staged in-place minor upgrades, and an airgap smoke bundle. Need product/eng/field alignment.

Raj: Important: define 'egress-preserve' precisely. For some clouds that's VIP/DNAT; for others it's static SNAT. Call out per-cloud eligibility.

Devon: Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) in-place minor upgrades <15m for 90% of tenants (<=2GB), 2) staged canary with automated rollback, 3) documented manual rollback + relay fallback, 4) airgap bundle offline install smoke tests pass.

Lina: Field ask from FinOps customers: provide explicit cost estimate for relay fallback; include token/egress unit delta in comms. Also they want a Console toggle to enable relay per-tenant during rollout.

Samir: Network constraints: include a short preflight checklist for NetOps (DNAT/VIP steps, required firewall rules, KMS access windows). For "no-egress-change" customers we should require NetOps sign-off and a pre-provisioned mapping.

Marta: Rough estimates: eng 10 dev-days, infra packaging 3 days, QA matrix 6 days, docs + comms 2 days. Contingency +25%.

Devon: Test matrix: small-state fast-path, large-state staged-path, NAT gateway, BGP peering, dual-stack, and KMS rotation during upgrade. Add synthetic traffic replay for transient regressions.

Marta: Action items: @Devon write staged-rollback spec and automation playbook; @Lina draft comms + cost bullets; @Raj enumerate cloud eligibility for egress-preserve; @Samir write NetOps preflight checklist. Review Friday 10:00 PT.
